purpose: Implementation guidance for a visual, adaptive GeoGuessr practice system; evidence reviewed 2026-10-18.
evidence_boundary: No cited study validates this complete curriculum, exact phase order, session length, mastery threshold, or scheduler for GeoGuessr. ADHD findings are task- and sample-specific, not universal prescriptions or clinical treatment guidance.

requirements.requirement: Make Practice the primary action. Maintain a small active set of concepts and generate the next map from demonstrated weaknesses, due reviews, contrasting alternatives, and limited new content. Explain the selection in one sentence.
requirements.basis: Keybr's official implementation starts with six frequent letters, targets the weakest included key, and expands against a configurable speed target. Adaptive perceptual-category sequencing improved efficiency in Mettler and Kellman's experiments.
requirements.caveat: Six concepts and any new/review percentage would be product heuristics. Keybr is an implementation analogy, not GeoGuessr learning evidence.

requirements.requirement: Store observed attempt, assessed concept, location identifier, correct/incorrect/unknown evidence, cue visibility, self-report versus verified result, date, and whether the example was previously seen. Mark missing observations unknown. Do not infer per-clue mastery from map completion or one multi-cue state guess.
requirements.basis: Generalization requires classification of unseen instances; visible cues and valid reasoning distinguish evidence of a particular skill from a lucky correct region guess.
requirements.caveat: These data fields and attribution safeguards are design judgments. Without a reliable results integration, label learner-entered outcomes as self-reported.

requirements.requirement: Show concrete evidence such as 7 correct of 10 assessed attempts across 8 locations, with last review date. Use states such as new, practicing, and ready for a mixed check. Avoid precision-looking mastery percentages, repeated mastery celebrations, or permanent mastered labels after one streak.
requirements.basis: Keybr's confidence is target time divided by measured time; it is not statistical confidence. Immediate success does not establish durable generalization.
requirements.caveat: A score based on hand-chosen weights must be called a practice-priority estimate, not a calibrated probability. Exact promotion criteria require validation against delayed unseen rounds.

requirements.requirement: Give concise visual orientation, then mix the current concept with its nearest plausible alternatives. Include different appearances, lookalikes, absent-cue scenes, and ordinary locations. Keep advanced exceptions available behind progressive disclosure.
requirements.basis: Category structure affects blocked versus interleaved advantages. Contrast supports discrimination; within-category comparison can help identify shared features.
requirements.caveat: Do not claim a long isolated-clue basics phase is necessary. Mettler and Kellman's initial miniblocks never outperformed continuous adaptive interleaving.

requirements.requirement: Let the learner commit a guess before showing the answer. Post-guess feedback should show an annotated visual, the diagnostic feature, and the nearest alternative; deeper explanation is optional. Keep reveal and next under learner control and avoid automatic rapid advance.
requirements.basis: Retrieval improved retention and inference transfer in prose experiments. A specific ADHD probabilistic-learning study found impairment with immediate feedback but no group difference when feedback was delayed by seconds.
requirements.caveat: Neither immediate feedback nor deliberate delay is universally best. The proposed reveal control is a usability choice; these studies do not establish its optimal timing for GeoGuessr.

requirements.requirement: Offer one finite round batch at a time, show remaining rounds, save after each observation, and provide pause/resume and stop without losing progress. Make batch size adjustable. Use one primary action and suppress nonessential animation and notification clutter.
requirements.basis: Recent ADHD visual-discrimination research found comparable eventual performance with greater variability and lapses; a different category-learning study found poorer acquisition and slower strategy adoption. A single performance dip should not trigger punitive resets.
requirements.caveat: These studies did not test this interface, a fixed five-minute interval, or mandatory breaks. Batch size, visual simplicity, and learner control are accessibility-oriented design choices to evaluate with the user.

requirements.requirement: Revisit errors after intervening items, retain older concepts in later sessions, and reserve unseen locations for delayed mixed checks. Use neutral test-map titles and hold out local road corridors where feasible. Confirm a concept across multiple examples before reducing its practice priority.
requirements.basis: Spacing depends on desired retention duration; adaptive category studies assessed unseen exemplars and a one-week delayed test.
requirements.caveat: Review intervals, corridor separation, per-concept minimums, and mix ratios are operational safeguards to pilot, not established optimal parameters.

requirements.requirement: Separate country/topic content from the scheduler. A topic provides concept identifiers, prerequisites if defensible, contrast links, source references, annotated visuals, and eligible locations; the engine keeps observations and selects batches. Track clue recognition and independent regionguessing separately.
requirements.basis: A correct cue-label association and unprompted application are different tasks; adaptive selection requires observable evidence at the relevant skill level.
requirements.caveat: This is architecture and measurement judgment, not an experimental result. Geography, landscape, and ordinary no-feature scenes must supplement a clue-only source collection.

mettler2014.title: Adaptive Response-Time-based Category Sequencing in Perceptual Learning
mettler2014.scope: Natural butterfly categories, not GeoGuessr; accuracy and speed informed sequencing.

butler2010.title: Repeated testing produces superior transfer of learning relative to repeated studying
butler2010.scope: Four prose-knowledge experiments; inference transfer after one week.

cepeda2008.title: Spacing effects in learning: A temporal ridgeline of optimal retention
cepeda2008.scope: Fact learning; optimal spacing varied with retention interval.

gabay2018.title: Feedback Timing Modulates Probabilistic Learning in Adults with ADHD
gabay2018.scope: Laboratory probabilistic associations; does not prescribe one feedback schedule for all tasks.

kuznetsova2025.title: Mechanisms of Learning in Adults With ADHD During an Ecologically-Valid Visual Discrimination Task
kuznetsova2025.scope: Published online 2025, issue 2026; 53 ADHD adults and 18 controls; visual gestalt discrimination, not a UX intervention.

roark2025.title: Category learning difficulties in ADHD across modalities and multiple learning systems
roark2025.scope: 29 ADHD and 31 control young adults in final sample; laboratory auditory/visual rule-based and information-integration categories; heterogeneous strategy adoption.
